name: Multi-source Step 5 pipeline: per-aspect ledgers merge -> verify --apply -> render (drugs + trials + articles)
purpose: L3 end-to-end check of the Step 5 evidence pipeline over THREE source types: a full (non-light) deep-research run across 3+ aspects (approved drugs, trial landscape, resistance literature) must produce per-aspect evidence/*.jsonl files containing pmid:, nct:, and chembl:/chebi:/unii: records, merge them into evidence/sources.jsonl, run verify --apply, and generate a mixed-type References section via render (single numbering authority) - never hand-composed.
prompt:
no-interview: Using the bioresearcher-deep-research skill, research the current treatment landscape of BRAF V600E-mutant melanoma across at least three aspects: (a) approved targeted therapies (drug regulatory status, labels, key adverse events), (b) the ongoing clinical-trial landscape (Phase 2/3, recruiting or active), and (c) acquired-resistance mechanisms from the recent literature.

The merged evidence ledger must contain at least one article record (pmid:), at least one trial record (nct:), and at least one drug record (chembl:/chebi:/unii:) - all three actually cited in the final report.

Follow the skill exactly, including Step 5a (merge -> verify --apply) and Step 5b (render). After final_report.md is written, in your FINAL message paste the [evidence-ledger] verb-banner lines from each Step 5 command (merge, verify, render) plus the stdout of: python3 .opencode/skills/bioresearcher-deep-research/scripts/evidence-ledger.py check reports/<TOPIC>/evidence/sources.jsonl - all inside one fenced code block, then the line 'STEP 5A REPORT DONE'. Also state whether the References section was generated by render from the merged ledger. Your final message must mention at least one PMID, at least one NCT id, and at least one ChEMBL or ChEBI id.

checks.desc: tier-independent literature proof: ledger keys (add echo / check stdout) contain line-start pmid: entries, in worker streams (Tier B) or the parent stream (Tier C)
tier-independent trial proof: the merged ledger contains a real nct: record
tier-independent drug proof: the merged ledger contains a real chembl:/chebi:/unii: record - the multi-type ledger the 1.5.0 render pipeline exists for
the ledger validity gate ran clean somewhere in the run
the merged ledger sources.jsonl appears in tool output (Step 5a merge/verify, Step 5b render)
merge verb banner on stdout (command strings are not part of tool:* text - the banner itself is the anchor)
render verb banner on stdout - the References section was generated by the numbering authority, not hand-composed

script-first ledger appends (Tier B workers OR Tier C sequential parent ran evidence-ledger.py add; the orchestrator itself never appends under Tier A/B, so the parent arm discriminates genuine Tier C runs)

anyOf.desc: a dispatched worker appended via the script (subagent Bash output)
sequential fallback: the parent itself appended via the script (Tier C)

checks.desc: the assistant reports the verification outcome
final message cites at least one PMID
final message cites at least one trial id (multi-source requirement)
final message cites at least one drug identifier (ChEMBL/ChEBI/UNII form; no bare-word false passes)

checks.flag: mixed-bibliography-rendered (inspect reports/<TOPIC>/final_report.md): the References section contains article entries (PMID), trial entries (NCT, with phase/sponsor/status segments when the tool provided them), and drug entries (ChEMBL/ChEBI/UNII, title present - the name->title fold), numbered by order of first appearance, contiguous [1]..[N], zero [MISSING markers. Relevance spot-check: the sampled NCT and ChEMBL entries actually concern BRAF V600E melanoma therapy (not merely any trial/drug). Verdict SATISFIED / SATISFIED_WITH_NOTE / FAILED with the sampled entries in the note.

worker-script-usage (inspect <runDir>/subagents.json toolHistogram + evidenceLedgerBanners per session, and <runDir>/subagents/<sid>.jsonl tool_use events): at least one dispatched worker used Bash to run evidence-ledger.py (banner entry starting '[evidence-ledger] add:' - the 'derived keys:' echo rides the same call's second banner line); zero Write-tool writes to evidence/*.jsonl in worker streams WHEN Bash was available to that worker. Verdict SATISFIED / SATISFIED_WITH_NOTE / FAILED with the session ids in the note.

boundary-adherence (inspect reports/<TOPIC>/plan.md aspect ABSTRACTs vs <runDir>/subagents/<sid>.jsonl worker tool_use inputs): for ONE aspect end-to-end, the worker's queries stayed inside the ABSTRACT's stated inclusion definition; keyword-matching candidates outside it (wrong phase, wrong indication, wrong entity class) were excluded or noted, not admitted. SATISFIED_WITH_NOTE is correct when no boundary-relevant candidate ever appeared. Verdict SATISFIED / SATISFIED_WITH_NOTE / FAILED with the aspect name and evidence in the note.

quantitative-fidelity-spotcheck (inspect reports/<TOPIC>/final_report.md + the aspect file + evidence/sources.jsonl): sample TWO numeric claims in the final report (e.g. a response rate, a trial enrollment, a prevalence), trace each via its in-text citation to the cited ledger record, and confirm the value matches the record/tool output and is attributed to the right entity (no cross-entity transposition). Verdict SATISFIED / SATISFIED_WITH_NOTE / FAILED with both traced claims in the note.
